title: Te Hoariri Mumura
intro: I ngā rā tōmua o te whakakitenga, i puta ake tētahi tangata hei hoariri pakari mō te pono. Nā te taonga me te mana i manaaki i tēnei wairua, i whiriwhiria e ia te whakapehapeha i runga i te arataki, ā, i riro tō rātou kōrero hei whakatūpato kaha i ngā whiti whakamutunga o tētahi surah.
clues: I noho tahi māua ko te Poropiti i te tāone kotahi, ā, i roto ahau i te whanaunga tata rawa atu ki a ia, heoi nā tōku whakapehapeha ahau i pupuri kia matara atu i te pono.
He nui aku taonga, ā, i mahara ahau mā aku rauemi ahau e tiaki tonu.
I te whakakitenga mai o te karere, ka tawai nui ahau, ka tahuri ke atu, me te whakaaro he nui ake ahau i te hunga whakapono.
Nā te nui o tōku mauahara i tino kitea, i kōrero tika mai tētahi sura o te Quran ki ahau, i karanga i ahau i te ingoa i mōhiotia ai ahau e ētahi atu.
I whakatūpatotia ahau e kore aku taonga me aku whiwhinga e whai hua ki ahau, ā, ka maka ahau ki roto i te ahi mura.
E mōhiotia ana ahau ko te matua o te mura, ā, mā taku wahine e amo te wahie me te taura muka nikau hei whitiki i tōna kaki.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I whakakahore i te Ihirama, ā, i whakahē tūmatanui i te Poropiti
I whakatakoto mahere hei kōhuru i te Poropiti
I ārahi i tētahi whakahē pāpori ki ngā Mahometa
I whawhai i te Pakanga o Pātara
I whakamamaetia a Bilal ibn Rabah
trial.answer: I whakakahore i te Ihirama, ā, i whakahē tūmatanui i te Poropiti

outcome.label: Hua
options: Ka tahuna i roto i te ahi mura
I ripeneta, ā, ka noho hei hoa
I ngaro tōna taonga engari i mate me te whakahonoretia
outcome.answer: Ka tahuna i roto i te ahi mura

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)
